match: # One rule per line. Foursquare labels are paths
category: e.g. "Dining and Drinking > Restaurant > Burger Joint".

match: # Each rule is a word or phrase matched case-insensitively and as whole words against one step of that path.
#   steak*     a trailing * matches the start of a word ("Steakhouse")
#   ^american  a leading ^ matches only at the start of the step ("American Restaurant"
# EXCLUDE rules are checked against every step: a place under "Bar" or labelled "Hookah Bar" is dropped
# whatever else it is. "Juice Bar" is not a "Bar" step
# Other rules are checked from the most specific step upwards
category: and the first step that matches wins

match: # "Lebanese Restaurant" under "Middle Eastern Restaurant" is Levantine only. A place with several labels gets

category: so overlap is expected: a café-bakery-breakfast spot gets all three.

match: # KEEP keeps a place without giving it a category (a plain "Restaurant"); it's ranked with whatever its label says.
